# Best noise-cancelling headphones under $100

Prices move a lot, so check the current price before you buy. I only have review pages, not live store listings, so most links go to the review pages, which have the retailer price buttons.

## Top picks

**1. Anker Soundcore Space Q45: best noise cancelling for the money**
- RTINGS ranks it the best budget ANC headphone it has tested. It quiets engine rumble and chatty coworkers well, and the price hovers around $100. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)
- Downsides: some owners report the headband cracking over time.
- The sources disagree on battery life. RTINGS says 28 hours, while CartIQ says 50 hours with ANC off and 38 with it on. Treat the battery figure with caution. [CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/)

**2. Soundcore Space One: best overall per Best Products (about $100)**
- It has adaptive ANC, a good companion app with EQ, rotating ear cups, and 55 hours of battery. It's a bit heavy. [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/)
- Dealectric lists a discount code, AFSC20, that it says takes it from $99.99 to $80 (last tested Oct 22). The store has the final say at checkout. This link is an affiliate link, so the site gets paid if you buy through it: [Soundcore Space One](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-space-one). [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/)

**3. Sony WH-CH720N: best for light weight (about $99)**
- At 192 g it's very light, with Sony's V1 processor and a dual noise sensor system. It only supports SBC and AAC codecs. [CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/)

## Cheaper options

- **Anker Soundcore Life Q30:** RTINGS' pick for best over-ear under $100, with good ANC against engines and chatter and about 44 hours of battery. It leaks sound, so people nearby may hear your music. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/over-ear-headphones-under-100)
- **Anker Soundcore Life Q20 (2024):** RTINGS' best cheap pick. It's close to the Q45 on noise cancelling, with 49 hours of battery, but it has weaker bass-range cancelling and a creaky plastic build. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)
- **Edifier Atom Max (about $45):** the best budget pick per Best Products, with hybrid ANC, 45 hours of battery, and a foldable design. [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/)
- **1MORE SonoFlow SE (about $65):** 70-hour battery and wired USB-C, but weaker ANC and no app. [CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/)

## Other picks by need

- **Calls:** JBL Tune 760NC (about $79). RTINGS says it has the best mic in its under-$100 list, but its ANC is mediocre. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/over-ear-headphones-under-100)
- **Durability:** CMF Headphone Pro. It has stainless-steel hinges and splash resistance, but I don't have its price or ANC details. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)
- **Travel:** Urbanista Solar (about $79). It charges from light and has 80 hours of battery, though some buyers report durability issues. [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/)

## My recommendation

For the strongest noise cancelling, get the **Soundcore Space Q45**. If you want a lighter pair or a better app, the **Space One** at around $80 is the better deal. Under $50, the **Edifier Atom Max** is the pick.
